fields.description: When off, the read-only Instant Assessment is hidden. Turn on once the accounts and tier bands below are configured.
fields.label: Enable Profit First

fields.description: Period the Instant Assessment is computed over. Trailing 12 Months is recommended: it is already an annual figure for tier selection and smooths seasonality. This Month annualises x12 and flags the tier as provisional.
fields.label: Assessment Window

fields.description: Which target bucket receives the leftover paise so allocations always reconcile to Real Revenue to the cent.
fields.label: Rounding Sink
fields.options:

fields.description: ERPNext company the sweep posts against (5b). Defaults to the site's default company.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: When on, a draft sweep proposal is created automatically on each allocation day (you still approve it manually before any money moves).
fields.label: Auto-create draft sweeps on schedule

fields.description: Days of the month to allocate on (Profit First suggests the 10th & 25th, but choose any days). A day past the month's length falls on the last day of that month.
fields.label: Allocation Days

fields.description: The five Profit First accounts. Income is the 100% reference; Profit, Owner's Pay, Tax and Operating Expenses are the allocation buckets.
fields.label: Accounts

fields.options: Target percentages for each annual Real-Revenue band. The four percentages in every row must sum to 100. Bands are lower-inclusive: a gym sitting exactly on a band edge falls into the higher tier. Localise the rupee bands to your market.

fields.description: Real-Revenue tier table (TAPs). Editable so the bands can be localised to the gym's currency.
fields.label: Tier Bands

fields.default: The Instant Assessment is read-only: it computes Current Allocation % (CAP) from your actual data and compares it to the Target Allocation % (TAP) for your Real-Revenue tier. It moves no money and posts no ledger entries. The Profit row is a residual (Real Revenue minus recorded expenses) and overstates true profit until Owner's Pay and Tax spend are tagged via Expense Category.
fields.label: About
